Actions: generate (prompt→code), list_library (user saved indicators), get_indicator (by id), delete_indicator, get_draft (poll generation status), save (persist to library). Returns full indicator code, params, and metadata. Behavior: READ-ONLY. Does not place orders, move funds, or mutate your exchange account. Live / near-real-time data. Auth: X-Api-Key or x402 payment proof (X-PAYMENT / __x_payment). Anonymous unauthenticated calls receive HTTP 402 with payment accepts.
